security_spec.violation_condition: XiangShan implements both Smrnmi and H extensions but the mnstatus CSR hardcodes MNPV to 0 or omits the field entirely, causing MNRET to return to the wrong virtualization mode; OR XiangShan implements Smrnmi without H extension but instantiates a writable MNPV field, creating a dead architectural bit that violates the reserved-field-zero requirement
security_spec.summary: mnstatus.MNPV must be conditionally instantiated based on H extension presence: absent H→bit hardwired to 0 per reserved-field rule, present H→bit must capture and restore virtualization mode on RNMI entry/exit; mismatch causes MNRET to return to incorrect privilege/virtualization level
